Terms · Updated 24 August 2026

Terms

Short version: $4,000 for the standard build, half to start and half when you are happy. You own the site and the domain. Everything ongoing is month to month and you can stop whenever you like.

Who you are dealing with

Growthbound Media, run by Daniel, based in Newcastle, NSW. Contact details are in the footer of every page.

The demo

The free demo is free. You do not pay for it, you are not committed by asking for it, and if you do not want to go ahead that is the end of it. The demo stays up while we are talking and I take it down afterwards. It is not indexed by search engines and it is not a live site.

What the build costs

The standard build is $4,000. Half to start. Half when you are happy. The first half starts the work, the second is due when you have reviewed it and you are happy for it to go live. Bigger scope, more pages, migrations and custom work quoted properly after a look.

If the job turns out to be bigger than the standard build, I will tell you the number before I start it, not after.

Ongoing costs

Hosting and security is $90/month and starts the day the site goes live. The Growth plan is $750/month and includes hosting and security, so it replaces that cost rather than adding to it. Both are month to month with no lock-in and no minimum term. Give me a month's notice to stop.

What you have to do

Send me the photos, the details of your services and areas, and any licence or insurance information you want shown. I will chase you once or twice, but a build cannot finish without them, and a job that goes quiet for more than 60 days gets paused until you come back to it.

Who owns what

You own the domain, the content and the finished site. Once the build is paid for it is yours, and if you ever want to move it somewhere else you can take it with you. Photos and text you give me stay yours, and you are confirming you have the right to use them.

What I will not do

I will not invent reviews, licence numbers, ABNs, insurance claims or awards. If you cannot substantiate something, it does not go on your site. This protects you more than it protects me.

What I cannot promise

I cannot promise a Google position, a number of enquiries or a volume of work. Nobody honest can, because Google decides rankings and your market decides the rest. What I do promise is that the site is built properly, the technical groundwork is done, and on the Growth plan I keep working on it.

If something goes wrong

Tell me. Most things are a five minute fix and I would rather hear about it than have you sitting on it. Nothing here limits any rights you have under Australian Consumer Law.

Changes

Last updated 24 August 2026. If these change, the date changes with them.
